name: Caption and on-screen text readability
summary: Contrast, size, duration, and safe-area rules that keep text legible and accessible.
qualityChecks: contrast ratio meets the accessibility minimum against the busiest frame behind it
text dwells long enough to be read at a normal rate
text sits inside the title-safe area
captions do not obscure a protected region
failureModes: contrast measured against an average frame rather than the worst one
text that survives a still check but is illegible over motion

provenance.claim: text requires a minimum contrast ratio against its background to be accessible
captions provide an equivalent for audio content
Final Cut can create closed captions natively
